name.km: ចៀនសាច់មាន់

description: Simply fried until golden and crisp, served with a dipping sauce.
descriptionKm: ចៀនស្ងួត — ក្រៀម និងឆ្ងាញ់។
equipmentKm: ខ្ទះ ឬ ម៉ាសុីនចៀន

ingredients.notesKm: កាត់ជាដុំៗតូច

ingredients.itemKm: ប្រេងសម្រាប់ចៀន

ingredients.notesKm: សម្រាប់បរិភោគ

instructions.text: Prepare the chicken: cut into bite-sized pieces.
instructions.textKm: រៀបចំសាច់មាន់៖ កាត់ជាដុំៗតូច។

instructions.text: Pat dry and dust lightly with seasoned rice flour.
Heat oil to 170°C. Fry the chicken until cooked through and no longer pink and crisp.
instructions.tip: Fry in small batches so the oil stays hot and the crust stays crisp.

instructions.text: Serve with sweet chili sauce or tuk trey p'aem.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយក្ដៅ។
